text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's finally... the day of the Sprinters 
Stakes. I'm going to put everything I've 
worked for up until today into this race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, Trainer. So much has 
happened, hasn't it? I'm so glad, after 
all, that you're my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm off to become the prettiest flower of 
all. Please... watch over me, okay?
